performance_anti_patterns: Iterating mailing.contact records in Python for large lists (use SQL)
Writing to mailing.trace individually for bulk operations (use create(records, batch=True))
Not using _trigger() on crons for near-real-time MA execution
Processing marketing.trace process_event for every email event without batch collection
